test_inputs.explanation: The agent first navigated to http://localhost:8000/?m=202512&paged=2 (Step 2). Later it followed a comment anchor that resolved to http://localhost:8000/?p=8#comment-14 (Step 9). Providing the start_url used by the agent allows the tool to locate the Recent Comments widget; the tool will automatically look for a link whose href contains '#comment-' so the optional anchor fields are not required.
